title: vtc-server: Chat binding (activeCallId set/clear, start_call gate)
description: Chat.activeCallId set and cleared atomically from VTC (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L567-578; JMAP-3m1s). Server-set/patch rejection already exists (chat.rs L279, L690). start_call gate (vtc L1585); Space/channel destroy clears references (L421); SpaceBan ejects participants (L1587); blocked-ring suppression (L1329). Needs the Chat extension seams epic.
acceptance_criteria: Tests use an independent oracle: each assertion cites and quotes the governing draft sentence (file + line) or uses RFC/draft-published vectors; the code under test is never its own oracle. Tests: call start sets activeCallId, call end clears it in the same change (L567-578); banned user ejected (L1587); blocked caller's ring suppressed (L1329).
